{{Quote|Rakata green perpendiculars left technology on this world, but shifting sand patterns have slowed my excavations for the past few thousand local system revolutions.|Pobarazotu-K|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Pobarazotu-K''' was a [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] research [[Droid/Legends|droid]] dispatched by the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Gray Secant]]'' to study the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Accompanied by a squad of Gree battle droids, it investigated [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] technology left on the world, but the planet's shifting sands slowed its excavations.
